title: Canonical valid ReadPropertyMultiple
purpose: Provide a conservative confirmed ReadPropertyMultiple request with complete BACnet/IP framing and a small payload region beyond the service selector for mutation into richer object and property lists.
expected_behavior: A BACnet/IP parser should accept the frame, parse a confirmed request APDU with invoke ID 0x01 and service choice 0x0E, and enter ReadPropertyMultiple handling with additional payload bytes available for service-specific validation.
constraints_preserved: BVLC header uses type 0x81 and function 0x0A before NPDU and APDU.
BVLC length 0x000F matches the 15-byte message length.
APDU begins with confirmed-request type high nibble 0x00.
Confirmed APDU includes control octet, invoke ID, service choice, and trailing payload.
All payload bytes fit within the declared BVLC length.
issue_safety_notes: No issue-specific shaping was used. This is a conservative validly framed seed with a short payload region rather than a replay of any malformed artifact.
